plan.do: Starter fight kit for both: Harris 500 shotgun, Light Armor, Pouch, Painkillers, Steel Plates, Lockpick, Sports Bag, plus one Action Camera
plan.why: Every early fight is inside 10 m, where a $3,500 shotgun downs a player in two shells, about as fast as a $115k SMG. This camera unlocks the purple one you'll buy for the Drill. Keep every green decoder you find; shops don't sell them, and three plus $10k become a purple one at the Suspicious Door.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Land Plot Title I: rent a level 1 plot next to a Reservoir
plan.why: Opens tier I guns, armor and your own car. Pick a hex next to a Reservoir: each harvest gets a 50% chance of extra bags.
plan.label: player

plan.do: Fight kit I: KL-545 rifle and Medium Armor for both, Pouch II, Flash Grenades, First Aid Cabinet
plan.why: The KL-545 is the best-value rifle for street fights. Flashes break contact. The cabinet lets you heal and respawn at base.
plan.label: data

plan.why: The only own car at level 1: 84 km/h vs 76 for the free rental, 4 seats, and it takes mods (rentals can't). The ECU stays on the car when you die.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Bushes can't be bought. Plant every one you find; they regrow after each harvest. $250k for the room plus $70k for the first table.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Grow Tables 2 to 6 + a Fan on each
plan.why: Add a table each time you have 6 more bushes; gun shops, gear stores and raided bases have them. A Fan cuts grow time 12%. This is the one passive earner, and it grows while you fight.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Land Plot Title II: move to a level 2 plot
plan.why: Opens Mini Drills, USB Hacking Tools, tier II rifles and armor, the Royal E and Water Pumps.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Mini Drills crack the big safes in locked rooms, which drop decoders and loot. One player got 25 decoders in two runs. Keep the green ones — don't sell them. The Master Key opens safes and cage shelves on bases you raid.
plan.label: player

plan.do: Fight kit II: RC 5.56 and Assault Armor for both, Injectors
plan.why: Other crews wear tier II armor by now. The RC 5.56 keeps its damage out to 60 m, and Injectors heal fast mid-fight.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Start raiding: convert decoders at the Suspicious Door, then hit unfused Grow Rooms and trailers
plan.why: At the Suspicious Door, 3 green decoders plus $10k become 1 purple, or a spare full purple Action Camera becomes 1 purple — we checked both in-game. Save one purple camera for the Drill; the 3-green route is the cheap one. Players report a bare trailer, Grow Room or Workshop has 5 defense (5 green, 2 purple, or 1 legendary), and a Chemical Lab has 3. Skip heavy fused houses. Hack the gate from outside, then one building at a time. One of you hacks, the other covers on foot — you can't shoot from the car. Grab grow product and loose loot first, Master Key the safes, and leave before they repair the panel. Alarms warn the owner. Eviction Rights were pulled on Nov 17, so this is for loot, not the plot.
plan.label: player

plan.do: Drill kit: Code Tablet research, 2 USB Hacking Tools, $50k
plan.why: Fill each USB by hacking 5 computers in locked rooms, then trade a full purple (tier II) Action Camera, both USBs and $50k for the Drill at Lenny's. The Camera II research and buy are an extra $65k if you don't have one yet — Camera I does not barter. The Drill opens the bank's vault door at level 2; you don't need the ID Card for it.
plan.pays: one vault: 6 × $10k cash, 5 × $60k money bags, 3 safes
plan.label: data

plan.why: You fight on foot, so the car's job is getting there first and getting away. The Royal E is the fastest level 2 car (91 km/h) and much quicker off the line than the Titan (70 vs 45). The Titan carries 6 cargo slots to the Royal E's 2, so take it instead if you haul what you catch. The Turbo stays on the car when you die.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Land Plot Title III: move to a level 3 plot
plan.why: Only if you'll go for the bank's gold room or have 20+ hours of play left; otherwise stop here and bank the rest. Opens Deposit Box Keys, the SR Reaper, Heavy Armor and UV Lamps.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Each bank deposit box adds a point; 60 fills the keys, about 5 vault visits. Trade them at Lenny's for the ID Card, which opens the gold room behind the vault door: 63 Gold Bars at $52k each.
plan.pays: gold room: about $3.3M at the Fence
plan.label: data

plan.do: Fight kit III: SR Reaper and Heavy Armor for both
plan.why: About the fastest gun through Heavy armor up close and the fastest at 60 m. Only while you keep winning fights: a gun is lost when you die, armor can be repaired with plates.
plan.label: data

tips.text: Don't sell green decoders. Three of them plus $10k barter into a purple one at the Suspicious Door.
tips.label: data

tips.text: Launder after every sale. Banked money can't be stolen by players.
tips.label: official

tips.text: Never leave cash or loot at base or in the trunk.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Optional side line: one Contraband Workbench in the Trailer ($40k), loaded by whoever reloads the Grow Room. Players net $10k to $20k a crate.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Optional, if you add a third player: clan wars. A small business is 3v3 for a $50k bet, pays $250k a win, and one Pharmacy panel showed +$83,333 an hour after that. Fights run 8pm to 6am.
tips.label: data

lastDay.text: Don't start long builds or research. They won't pay back before the raid.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Last grow cycle: harvest, then sell each bush to the Smuggler. A bush is worth $20k or more.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Sell everything. Every $500,000 you hold at the wipe is one more year of jail time, up to 40 years.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Banked cash is wiped too, but it still counts toward jail time.
lastDay.label: official

lastDay.text: Agree with your crew on which realm you all join next.
lastDay.label: data

bestRuns.lead: What each fight pays. All of these are player reports, one player's or squad's result, not a promise.

ranked.name: Store runs
ranked.note: One solo player made $600k in 3 hours. Gun shops and gear stores also have bushes.

ranked.name: Full Grow Room
ranked.note: 6 tables, 36 bushes. Grows while you fight or are offline.

perJob.name: Bank vault (level 2)
perJob.note: Drill only. 6 cash piles ($10k), 5 money bags ($60k) and 3 safes (Mini Drill, 2 min each). A cop pulls the Drill in 4 seconds, so one of you guards it.

perJob.name: Bank gold room (level 3)
perJob.note: Needs the ID Card too. 63 Gold Bars at $52k at the Fence; players report $1.5M to $5.9M per job.

perJob.name: Catching a seller
perJob.note: What one seller says he brings to a Fence per trip. Plus his gear.

perJob.name: ATM tip-off
perJob.note: How often it happens isn't known.

perJob.name: Base raid
perJob.note: One player raided a full Grow Room and kept its bushes. Takes about 25 decoders against green fuses.

tips.text: Pick stores by safes per minute, not size. A jewelry store with two safes beats a hotel with five cabinets.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Sell at your district's hub when you can. Kefir says it can pay well above Looty Bay.
tips.label: official

tips.text: Leave at about $100k in the bag. Smaller cash-outs lose less when a squad shows up.
tips.label: player

bestRuns.unknown: Car health, exactly how long a dead player's bag stays lootable, whether the bank vault Drill needs a minimum number of players, and real per-hour numbers for hunting other players.

duo.lead: Two players, one car, one base. You hunt together. Whoever is closer to base after a fight reloads the Grow Room.

items.text: Point: shotgun, goes in first and clears rooms. Overwatch: rifle, holds the car and the street out to 60 m.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Park nose-out at the exit and bail out on the far side, so the car is between you and the street. You can't shoot from inside it.
items.label: zoi

items.text: In stores: shoot the alarm box and cameras first, and hold the clerk at gunpoint instead of killing them.
items.label: player

items.text: One of you does all the research and buying, so nothing is paid for twice. Hand gear over.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Wait near a Fence or Smuggler as Civilians, then mask up in the car when a loaded seller pulls in. Kefir says camping drop-offs is intended.
items.label: official

items.text: Hit sellers while their hands are full: drawing a weapon drops the cargo they're carrying.
items.label: player

items.text: A masked player who dies drops their bag and gear. The bag stays lootable for at least a few minutes, so win the fight first, then loot. Cops and other crews can take it too.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Grab the cash pile off the Fence counter right after any sale. Anyone, cops included, can take it.
items.label: official

items.text: Outside the city anyone can be killed. Crews wait on the roads out for cars carrying bank loot.
items.label: player

items.text: Base raids: hit unfused Grow Rooms, trailers and Workshops outside your district. One of you hacks, the other covers on foot. Don't jump the fence to skip the gate — players got stuck inside.
items.label: player

items.text: Early in the wipe. Crews wear tier I armor and few cops have badge gear yet, so the first hours are the easiest fights.
items.label: player

items.text: When you outnumber them, their hands are full, or their armor is broken.
items.label: zoi

items.text: ATM tip-off: the city alert marks one ATM with a big cash batch, and the first crew to open it wins. No tool needed.
items.label: data

items.text: A third crew or the cops show up, or you're out of plates.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Your bag is full. A second robbery is where most players lose the first one.
items.label: player

items.text: Don't shoot civilians: 3 kills marks you Most Wanted and shows your location to the whole city.
items.label: data

items.text: Cornered by cops? Surrender: you lose the bag, not your gear. You can also offer a bribe from your bank, up to $200k.
items.label: data

items.text: Notoriety rises with each crime in one visit and resets when you leave. A duo starts at level 2 (×1.10), solo at 4 (×1.35), and level 5 pays ×1.50.
items.label: data

items.text: After a spree, sell together before you leave: at level 4 or 5 you match or beat the solo bonus, with two guns at the Fence.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Harvest bags: one of you sells alone for +35% ($40k became $54k), in small batches. The other covers from the car.
items.label: player

items.text: Cop shifts: lots of fights, little pay. $9k to $15k an arrest, $2k a kill, max 4 cops per city.
items.label: data

items.text: It warns both of you the moment a hack starts.
items.label: data

items.text: Whoever is closer goes home. The other one finishes the sale or banks, so the run isn't lost too.
items.label: zoi

items.text: You have time: each decoder takes about 12 seconds at the panel, so a fused building takes minutes.
items.label: player

items.text: After a hack, repair the panel on the spot. Your fuses survive and the defense comes back.
items.label: player

raids.lead: Raid other crews for the loot, and hold your own base the same way. Nothing protects an offline base except fuses and alarms.

items.text: Shops don't sell decoders. Keep every green one. At the Suspicious Door, 3 green plus $10k become 1 purple, or a spare full purple Action Camera becomes 1 purple. We checked both in-game.
items.label: data

items.text: Save one purple Action Camera for the bank Drill. Trading a camera for a decoder is the expensive route.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Players report a bare trailer, Grow Room or Workshop has 5 defense (5 green, 2 purple, or 1 legendary), and a Chemical Lab has 3. A Small House starts at 15, a Mansion at 30. Fuses add more. The 1 / 3 / 5 decoder points are player reports, not game files.
items.label: player

items.text: Hack the gate from outside, then one building at a time. Don't jump the fence to skip the gate — players got stuck inside and couldn't hack it.
items.label: player

items.text: Decoders don't open safes or cage shelves. That takes a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: One of you hacks, the other covers on foot. You can't shoot from the car. Grab grow product and loose loot first, then Master Key the safes, and leave before they repair the panel.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Each decoder takes about 12 seconds at the panel, so an alarmed owner may make it back. A location alarm warns everyone on the plot.
items.label: player

items.text: Eviction Rights were pulled from barter on Nov 17, for now. Raids are for loot, not taking the plot.
items.label: official

items.text: They hack the gate panel from outside, then a building's Security System with decoders until its defense hits zero. Then that building opens for a while.
items.label: player

items.text: One hack opens one building, not the whole base.
items.label: player

items.text: They go for the weakest money buildings first: the Grow Room and Chemical Laboratory have some of the lowest base defense.
items.label: player

items.text: Decoders don't open safes or cage racks. That takes a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: An open door lets anyone who jumps the fence walk straight in.
items.label: player

items.text: Best: nowhere. Sell it and bank the cash.
items.label: zoi

items.text: If it has to wait, put it in a cage rack or safe, so a raider also needs a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: Spread cash, loot and cargo over several buildings. Each one needs its own decoders, so raiders run out.
items.label: player

items.text: Not in the car. A trunk can reportedly be opened anywhere.
items.label: player

items.text: Fuse the Grow Room first. It holds your income and opens easily.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Fill slots with Fuse I first. It's the cheapest per point; move to bigger fuses when slots run out.
items.label: data

items.text: Put your Clan Alarm on the building that holds the most value. A panel has 3 alarm slots.
items.label: player

items.text: Alarms add no defense. They only warn you.
items.label: data

items.text: Close every door before you log off.
items.label: player

paysNote: Pays back is in hours you're online. The short end is math from game prices, the long end is from player reports.

cars.text: You can't shoot from a car; you have to get out first. Cars get you there, carry the loot and give you cover once you bail out.
cars.label: zoi

cars.text: So pick on acceleration and cargo, not top speed. Royal E: 91 km/h, acceleration 70, 2 cargo slots. Titan: 88 km/h, acceleration 45, 6 slots. Tensa: 84 km/h, acceleration 40, 1 slot.
cars.label: data

cars.text: Some wikis show 0–100 ratings instead of km/h (Royal E 62, Titan 55, Tensa 30). Those are the in-game stat bars; both put the cars in the same order.
cars.label: data

cars.text: Seats don't split them: all three seat 4. The Longhorn Wild and Buletti seat 2 and cost $5M and $12M+ with research; the Buletti can't carry shipments.
cars.label: data

cars.text: No source publishes car health or how much cover a car body gives. Car mods stay on the car when you die.
cars.label: data

rentOwn.text: Level 2 and 3: rent. Owning a level 2 settlement costs $1.5M more than renting, and level 3 costs $8M. The level 2 and 3 laundering taxes were raised on Nov 5 and aren't published, so neither pays back within one wipe.
rentOwn.label: data

rentOwn.text: Level 1: own if a free settlement is close in the first 3 days. It's $300k vs $150k. You skip the 5% tax and collect it from tenants, so it pays back in about 3 days if you launder $1M a day.
rentOwn.label: data

rentOwn.text: On a brand-new server you may have to own: you can only rent where someone already owns the settlement.
rentOwn.label: data

growCore.text: You're the hunters: buy fight power and a fast car first, and make money from fights, raids and the bank. The Grow Room is the one passive earner. Whoever is at base reloads it. When cash is spare, add Water Pumps at level 2 (−14% grow time, $620k for 6) and UV Lamps at level 3 (−24%, $2M).
growCore.label: data

plotSpace.text: Your plot needs a Grow Room, nothing more. Don't build a second one: bushes can't be bought, so it would sit empty.
plotSpace.label: zoi
